test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In which of the following states is the ‘International Cherry Blossom Festival’ celebrated annually?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Meghalaya.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The International Cherry Blossom Festival held in **Shillong, Meghalaya** concluded recently.
 
• For the first time, India & South Korea jointly celebrated this festival that witnessed the celebration of unique autumn flowering of **Himalayan Cherry Blossoms (scientifically known as the Prunus serrulata).**
 
• The capital, Shillong hosts the only Cherry Blossoms festival in India.
 
• The festival in Shillong hosts a **plethora of events like fitness art, fashion show, rock concerts and much more.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Meghalaya:(Sept 2024)

 
 
• Chief Minister - Conrad K Sangma.
 
• Governor - C. H. Vijayashankar
 
• Lok Sabha seats - 2.
 
• Rajya Sabha seats - 1.
